purpose: Resolve the Type-0x1E extended animation ED/FB side effects and correct the byte alignment of the earlier upper-pair stream note.

correction.previous_claim: The extended stream placed ED at 0x001237D8, FB at 0x001237E0, and FC at 0x001237E6.
correction.corrected_bytes: The ROM bytes at 0x001237C6 are 11D2 11D2 ED14000A0012046C 11BE 11BE 11C2 11C2 11C6 11C6 11CA 11CA 11CE FB00001ACC5E 11CE 11CE ...
correction.reason: ED consumes eight bytes and FB consumes six bytes; the apparent FC was a frame-reference misalignment.

ed.effect: Uses mode bit 0x10 for actor-relative addressing, selects byte/word/long width from the low mode bits, and writes the stream operand.
ed.this_instance: Mode 0x14 selects actor-relative long write; offset 0x000A receives 0x0012046C.

fb.effect: Advances past the opcode/mode byte and pushes the following long value on the interpreter stack; it does not directly call the target.
fb.this_instance: The pushed value is function address 0x001ACC5E, used by the common deferred callback mechanism.

extended_callback.effect: Advances GLOBAL_PRNG_STATE at 0x00FF7DEA with state = state*13 + 7, selects the low two bits, and conditionally queues audio/event IDs 0x5E, 0x5F, 0x60, or 0x61 when VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is set.
extended_callback.scene_effect: No write to SCENE_STATE, SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN, PLAYER_WORLD_X, PLAYER_WORLD_Y, PLAYER_VX, or PLAYER_VY.

decoded_steps.control_flow: loops through 0x0012048A/0x00120498 when conditions do not branch
falls into the same X/flag/field test family

movement_handoff.classification: actor-local movement/animation handoff; not a player launch, remote connector install, or scene transition

verified: The prior extended-stream address annotation was misaligned; the corrected ED and FB addresses are now recorded from a lossless decoder output.
ED installs an actor movement-stream pointer and FB queues a deferred random/audio callback address.
The movement stream can switch the actor animation root and stop movement, but its writes are actor-local and contain no scene gate.
negative_evidence: The corrected extended Type-0x1E stream contains no FC call at 0x001237E6.
The targeted opcode handlers and callback contain no direct scene-state, countdown, or player-coordinate transfer.
unresolved: A runtime trace still needs to reach the extended Type-0x1E branch naturally to correlate the deferred callback with actor-table state.
The exact upstream interaction condition that selects 0x001237C6 remains unresolved.
